dataflow.summary: Tree supplier places link directory under root; caller supplies link/file; joined path resolves to outside/file; file_size and sha256_file consume it.

reachability.summary: Directly reachable through exported library API; absent from CLI. Attacker must supply the tree or alter its entries.

codeEvidence.code: export func streaming_tree_hash(root,relative_paths,maximum_files){if !path_is_dir(root)||path_is_symlink(root)||maximum_files<1||maximum_files>100000||type(relative_paths)!="array"||len(relative_paths)>maximum_files{return {"ok":false,"error":"tree root or file-count bound is invalid"}};mut entries:=[];for relative in sort(relative_paths){if !safe_relative(relative){return {"ok":false,"error":"unsafe tree path"}};path:=root+"/"+relative;if !path_is_file(path)||path_is_symlink(path){return {"ok":false,"error":"tree entry is missing or unsafe"}};entries=push(entries,{"path":relative,"bytes":file_size(path),"sha256":sha256_file(path)})};manifest:=checksum_manifest(entries,"");manifest["streaming"]=true;manifest["files"]=len(entries);return manifest}
codeEvidence.explanation: Intermediate directories are joined without symlink checks before file_size and sha256_file.
codeEvidence.label: Only leaf symlink rejected

confidence.rationale: Reproduced by tests/audit_test.kujo against baseline, then verified rejected after component validation.

findings.remediation: Reject every relative path component that is a symlink before hashing. Require operator-owned stable roots; do not promise protection from hostile concurrent replacement.
remediationTests: tests/audit_test.kujo: real intermediate symlink is rejected

rootCause.summary: Lexical safe_relative rejects traversal components, but leaf-only symlink checks do not confine filesystem resolution.

severity.rationale: Requires a lower-trust supplied tree; exposes only an outside file hash/size, not contents. No network sink or remote service. Local state is not multitenant.

findings.summary: The exported tree hasher checks only the root and final file for symlinks. A supplied root/link/file can hash an outside file through a directory symlink.
findings.title: Intermediate directory symlinks escape the declared hash root

validation.summary: A real root/link -> outside fixture makes baseline streaming_tree_hash(root,[link/file],10) succeed; the same regression rejects it after the fix.
